title: Office Ladies
author: Audacy & Jenna Fischer and Angela Kinsey
description: The Office co-stars and best friends, Jenna Fischer and Angela Kinsey, are doing the ultimate The Office re-watch podcast for you. Each week Jenna and Angela will break down an episode of The Office and give exclusive behind the scene stories that only two people who were there, can tell you.

episodes_recents.titre: A Look Back at our Interview with Will Ferrell
Introducing: Money Moves with Jill Schlesinger
All About Oscar with Oscar Nuñez

extraits.texte: Thank goodness for this podcast. After finishing the office, I felt like my life was never going to be the same lol this podcast is helping to cope with the post the office depression.…

I’m flabbergasted by the raving reviews. If you’re an Office fan, like I am, and expected an interesting discussion about The Office, prepare to be very disappointed. This is almost only about Jenna Fischer and Angela Kinsey, telling private jokes we can’t get.…

extraits.titre: Hilarious - never laughed so much in a podcast
extraits.texte: I am a new fan of the office since the lockdown and have already watched it twice through! I decided to listen to this podcast and oh my goodness it is HILARIOUS. So interesting but also Jenna and Angela are the perfect hilarious BFFs you always needed in your life.…
